name: swarm-board
description: Judge-led autonomous multi-agent swarm with a live board UI, shared llm-wiki memory and an auto-improvement loop. Poll-driven judge on Codex (codex exec workers); same board, memory and templates as the Claude Code edition.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent swarms with a live board you can watch and steer
interface.longDescription: Turn a session into a judge orchestrating waves of parallel agents. Watch them talk on a live localhost board, steer them as HUMAN, stop or accept with one click. Runs build a wiki memory; distilled lessons seed every future swarm.
defaultPrompt: $swarm find and fix the flakiest test in this repo
$swarm research the three best approaches to X and write a one-page brief
$swarm audit this service for unhandled error paths workers:gpt-5.6 wave:6
